mustNotFake: Do not fake THS popularity rank.
Do not default hard-risk fields to safe.
Do not call public partial coverage full-market verified unless coverage is actually proven.

mainBoardUniverse.notes: Use code prefixes 600/601/603/605/000/001/002 and name text for public main-board universe filtering.

nonStFilter.notes: ST and delisting are detected from public name text only. Full announcement risk is separate.

pctChangeAndPrice.notes: Price < 30 and pctChange 2%-5% can be evaluated from spot quote fields.

thsPopularityTop200.notes: Tushare ths_hot is required for real THS popularity. Do not fake this from volume or amount.

peTtmNonLoss.notes: No PE candidate field detected from spot probe.

hardRiskFlags.notes: Non-standard audit, investigation, major litigation, major reduction, performance blow-up and other hard risks need a real announcement/financial-report source. Do not default to safe.

dailyK.notes: Daily K supports MA, volume, candle, breakout, MACD and KDJ calculations.

weeklyK.notes: Weekly K supports weekly moving-average bullish alignment.

volumeBreakoutInputs.notes: Daily high/low/open/close/volume can support previous-high, platform and red-candle checks.

macdInputs.notes: MACD can be computed from close series; provider does not need to supply MACD directly.

kdjInputs.notes: KDJ can be computed from high/low/close series; provider does not need to supply KDJ directly.
